title: PText golden fixture file
description: Language-neutral tool contract. One file per tool (fixtures/golden/<tool-id>.json); _registry.json holds cases that are not about one tool. Any port (TS core, MCP, browser, PHP, Python) must produce exactly expect.output and exactly expect.warnings, or fail with expectError.

tool.description: Tool id for every case in this file. Must equal the file name.

text.description: A string, or an array of lines joined with "\n" (add a trailing "" for a final newline).

name.description: Unique, starts with a short tool label, e.g. "csv-to-json: duplicate headers".

tool.description: Only in _registry.json, where cases target different tools.

edge.description: Bad data, ambiguity, limits or empty input. Cases with expectError or warnings count as edge cases too.

warnings.description: Warning codes in order. Omitted means no warnings.

expectError.description: The PTextError code the call must throw.
